text: Oh, lord. Dr. Koothrappali, as your superior, I forbid you from writing on my board! I am in every way.

text: You are not my superior. Oh, yeah? Can you do this?

text: Nice working with you. I'm sorry, for you.

text: Doing what? All right, you've made your point. I looked over the board and it turns out you were right. I didn't say that. Nevertheless, I didn't say it. Anyway, I would like you to come back and work for me.

text: So you were wrong. That's the only logical inference.

text: In this context for me could mean with me.

text: All right, but I have some conditions. I'll take the job. See you Monday.
